title: fix(triage): match path globs in linear time
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

## What changed
- Path globs compile once to cached RE2JS patterns (linear time): `**` and `*` keep their meaning, every other character is quoted and matches literally. A `?` in a stored glob is now literal; it previously acted as regex syntax.
- Packs reject globs longer than 200 characters (after trimming) and lists of more than 50 globs.

## Verification
- New glob tests: wildcard behaviour unchanged, metacharacters literal, a many-wildcard glob matches in under 100 ms, 3000 paths × 50 globs match in under 200 ms (~37 ms).
- `bun run check`, `bun run test` (694 pass).
